headerDisplay: Shows the camera of your Bambu Lab printers in the Home app. On each printer, turn on **LAN Mode Liveview** in the network settings, where the **IP address** and **LAN access code** are also shown. The **serial number** is in the device information. P1 and A1 printers have no RTSP stream: set a stream URL from an RTSP bridge under **Advanced**. [Setup guide](https://github.com/moifort/homebridge-bambu-lab#printer-setup)

printers.title: Printers
printers.description: Bambu printers to expose as HomeKit cameras.

name.title: Printer Name
name.description: The camera is named "<name> Camera" unless a camera name is set under Advanced.

model.title: Printer Model
model.description: Shown in the accessory information in HomeKit. P1 and A1 printers have no RTSP stream: they need a camera stream URL from an RTSP bridge (Advanced).

ipAddress.title: Printer IP Address
ipAddress.description: Shown in the printer's network settings. Reserve it in your router so it does not change. Not needed with a custom camera stream URL.

serialNumber.title: Printer Serial Number
serialNumber.description: In the printer's device information, or in Bambu Studio and Bambu Handy. It identifies the camera in HomeKit: changing it creates a new camera.

lanAccessCode.title: LAN Access Code
lanAccessCode.description: Shown in the printer's network settings, next to LAN Mode Liveview. Not needed with a custom camera stream URL.

cameraName.title: Camera Name
cameraName.description: Camera name in HomeKit, instead of "<printer name> Camera".

cameraRtspUrl.title: Camera Stream URL
cameraRtspUrl.description: Only for printers without their own RTSP stream (P1, A1) behind an RTSP bridge, or a stream relayed elsewhere. Leave empty to use the printer's RTSPS stream on port 322.

ffmpegPath.title: ffmpeg Path
ffmpegPath.description: Full path to the ffmpeg binary, if it is not in the PATH of the user running Homebridge.

validationMessages.pattern: Enter the printer's IP address (for example 192.168.1.50) or host name, without http:// or a port.
The serial number has only letters and digits, as shown on the printer (for example 01S00C123456789).
The LAN access code has 8 letters or digits, as shown in the printer's network settings.
Enter an rtsp:// or rtsps:// URL.
